title: Generative AI Lab
tagline: Create with AI and master prompts
objectives: Know what text, image, and music AI make
Tell weak prompts from strong ones

stages.title: AI That Creates!
stages.narration: Most AI analyzes things, it sorts or understands. Generative AI is different: it creates brand-new content that never existed before. Let's make something!

steps.text: You describe an idea in words…
The AI uses patterns it learned from human work.
A story, a picture, or a song appears!

stages.title: Generative or Not?
stages.prompt: Tap every task where the AI CREATES something brand new.

items.label: Unlock a phone with your face

feedback.correct: Yes! This makes brand-new content, that's Generative AI.
feedback.incorrect: This analyzes or sorts things that already exist, it doesn't create something new.

stages.title: What Will It Create?
stages.prompt: Generative AI can make text, images, or music. Pick what each request would create.

tasks.label: "Write an essay about space"
tasks.explain: Words on a page, that's text generation.

tasks.label: "A painting of a dragon surfing"
tasks.explain: A picture from a description is image generation.

tasks.label: "A new upbeat melody"
tasks.explain: An original tune is music generation.

tasks.label: "A funny poem about cricket"
tasks.explain: A poem is made of words, so it's text.

tasks.label: "Album cover art for a band"
tasks.explain: Artwork from a prompt is an image.

stages.title: Weak vs Strong Prompts
stages.prompt: A prompt is what you ask the AI. Strong prompts are specific about audience, topic, format, and tone. Sort each prompt.
stages.note: Weak prompts are vague. Strong prompts add details: who it's for, the topic, the format, and the tone.

cards.label: "Explain black holes to a 12-year-old using cricket examples."
"Write a funny 4-line poem about rainy days."

stages.title: Famous Generative AI Tools
stages.prompt: Tap each tool to see what it can create. Visit them all!

locations.label: ChatGPT / Claude
locations.info: Chat assistants that generate text, answer questions, and help you write and think.

locations.label: DALL·E
locations.info: Creates brand-new images from a written description, just type what you imagine.

locations.label: Gemini
locations.info: Works with text and pictures together to create, explain, and answer.

locations.label: Music AI
locations.info: Generates original melodies and beats from a short prompt.

locations.label: Video AI
locations.info: Turns a text idea into a short animated video clip. They all learned from huge amounts of human-made work.

stages.title: Creator's Final Test
stages.prompt: Score at least 80% to earn your Creative Genius badge.

questions.explain: Generative AI makes new text, images, music, or video.

questions.q: Which is a generative AI tool?
questions.explain: DALL·E generates images from a written description.

questions.q: How did generative AI learn to create?
options: By studying huge amounts of human-made content
questions.explain: It learned patterns from enormous datasets, then uses them to make new things.

options: The instruction you give an AI
questions.explain: A prompt is what you ask or tell the AI to do.

options: Explain black holes to a 12-year-old with cricket examples
questions.explain: It's specific about audience, topic, and style, so the AI gives a focused answer.

options: Clear audience, topic, format, and tone
questions.explain: Details guide the AI to a much better response.
It generates many kinds of brand-new content.

stages.title: Lab Complete!
messages: 🏆 You earned the Creative Genius Badge
You created with AI and mastered prompts
